Builds topology objects, links, tiles, layout, NUMA assignment, and validation.

# Purpose
This C file builds and finalizes a topology description in `fd_topo_t`. It provides helper functions to create the topology object, add workspaces, objects, links, and tiles, and connect tiles to links and shared-memory objects. The code also stores metadata in the `props` POD area, sets object names and IDs, and records how each tile uses each object with a read or write mode. The main purpose is to assemble a complete in-memory model of an application layout before the runtime uses it.

The file also performs the final setup for that topology. It validates the graph for correct workspace IDs, link use, producer and consumer counts, and duplicate or invalid connections. It assigns CPU affinity with [`fd_topob_auto_layout`](<#fd_topob_auto_layout>), computes workspace offsets and footprints in [`fd_topob_finish`](<#fd_topob_finish>), and assigns NUMA nodes based on tile placement and object use. The file uses public helper APIs from the topology, CPU, and POD layers, so it acts as a builder and finalizer for the topology data structure rather than as an executable.
